citation: 2024 presidential results by county (Alaska by state house district), Democratic and Republican votes, as compiled by Tony McGovern, US_County_Level_Election_Results_08-24, 2024_US_County_Level_Presidential_Results.csv (github.com/tonmcg), read Oct. 13, 2026. Checked against the game's official state totals (Clerk of the U.S. House): summed by state, the Democratic two-party share is within 0.01 everywhere (New York 0.008, Alaska 0.0005, the rest under 0.0001).
